subject.title: fix(gateway): Control UI bootstrap 401s over Tailscale Serve without a token

question: Should Control UI HTTP bootstrap/media/avatar reads accept tokenless Tailscale identity, and if so must they enforce the same browser-origin policy as the WebSocket Control UI path?
rationale: The PR changes an auth boundary that prior history and docs scoped to WebSocket, and the remaining blocker is a security/product boundary decision plus proof, not ordinary style follow-up.

options.title: Allow with origin gate
options.body: Permit the new HTTP read surface only after adding the WebSocket-equivalent origin check, negative regression coverage, docs alignment, and real Tailscale Serve proof.

options.title: Keep HTTP token-bound
options.body: Reject this HTTP auth-surface expansion and solve the dashboard bootstrap/media gap through bearer or device-token reads.

options.title: Accept broader reads
options.body: Intentionally accept verified tailnet identity for tokenless HTTP reads without an origin gate and document the cross-origin exposure assumption.

recommendation.title: Allow with origin gate
recommendation.body: Permit the new HTTP read surface only after adding the WebSocket-equivalent origin check, negative regression coverage, docs alignment, and real Tailscale Serve proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior WebSocket-only Tailscale scoping and docs update came from this history, so this is the clearest owner for the boundary decision.
